try: Open the studio's price book
how:
1. Click "Company" in the side navigation
2. Click "Price book"
expect: "Price book" opens on "My Items": the "Wet works" and "Kitchen" folders, item cards with unit prices, a "1 proposed" chip and "Kind: All".
in10: Different from 1.0: under Company, not Accounts

try: See one product from two suppliers
how:
1. Click the "Wet works" folder
2. Look at the two "Homogeneous tiles 600×600, supply and lay" cards
3. Click "My Items" in the path at the top to go back
expect: The same tile shows twice — "by Hafary" and "by Soon Bee Huat", each S$11.00 / sqft: one item per supplier.
in10: Different from 1.0: one vendor per item, not several

try: Add a new item with a price in cents
how:
1. Click "New" › "New item"
2. "Item name": Fluted feature wall panel · "Description": Oak veneer fluted panel, 20 mm slats, supply and install
3. "Kind": Purchase · "Unit": sqft
4. "Cost (S$)": 28.50 · "Markup (S$)": 11.50
expect: Under Markup it reads "Unit price S$40.00" — the cents are kept exactly as typed.
in10: Different from 1.0: markup in S$, not a percentage

try: Give it a trade, a supplier and a product link
how:
1. "Category": pick Carpentry (the list is the studio's trades)
2. "Vendor": Timber Craft
3. "Website link": www.example.com/fluted-panel
4. Click "Add to My Items"
expect: A message says "Fluted feature wall panel added to My Items"; its card reads "by Timber Craft · S$40.00 / sqft · Carpentry".
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Add a photo of the panel
how:
1. Click the "Fluted feature wall panel" card
2. In "Edit item", click the "Photo" box and pick fluted-panel.jpg
3. Click "Save"
expect: A message says "Item saved" and the card now shows your photo instead of the cart icon.
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Change its cost and read the item's history
how:
1. Open the fluted panel again
2. "Cost (S$)": 30.50, then click "Save"
3. Open it once more and scroll down to "History"
expect: History lists "Added by Dane" and two "Changed by Dane" entries — "Photo added" and "Cost S$28.50 → S$30.50". Unit price is now S$42.00.
in10: Different from 1.0: every change kept, before → after

try: Sort the list by price
how:
1. Click "List view" (the list icon, top right)
2. Click the "Unit price" column heading
3. Click it again
expect: Items sort cheapest first with an up arrow, then dearest first with a down arrow.
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Show only one trade's items
how:
1. Click "Filters" (the funnel icon)
2. "Category": Tiling, then click "Done"
3. When checked, open "Filters" again and click "Clear All"
expect: Only the two Homogeneous tiles items show, each marked with its folder "Wet works"; "Clear All" brings every item back.
in10: Different from 1.0: a category filter, not grouped lists

try: Look at an item a designer proposed
how:
1. Click the "1 proposed" chip at the top
2. Click "Skirting, PVC 80 mm"
3. Read the bar at the top, then click "Cancel"
4. Click "1 proposed" again to see every item
expect: The bar says Sarah proposed it and only their quotes use it until approved; "Send back…" and "Approve" wait for chapter 10.
in10: Different from 1.0: not used studio-wide until approved

try: Re-price two items at once, then undo
how:
1. Tick "Vinyl flooring, supply and install" and "Electrical point, new"
2. In the bar at the bottom, click "Set markup"
3. "Markup (% of cost)": 30, then click "Apply to 2 items"
4. On the message "2 items changed", click "Undo" straight away
expect: Unit prices change to S$7.15 and S$71.50, then Undo puts them back to S$7.00 and S$70.00.
in10: Different from 1.0: a markup % re-prices the items

try: Export My Items to a spreadsheet
how:
1. Click the ⋮ menu ("More options", top right)
2. Click "Export My Items…"
3. Keep "All items" and "Choose file format": CSV
4. Click "Export"
expect: my-items.csv downloads and a message says how many items were exported as CSV; the file has an Item column with every name.
in10: Different from 1.0: live items only, with their names

try: Import a supplier's price list
how:
1. Click "New" › "Import from a spreadsheet…"
2. Drop supplier-price-list.csv on the box (or click "browse")
3. In "Import into My Items", read the "In My Items" column and the notes below
expect: Rows read New · Updates its price · New · Repeats — skipped; notes name the match, the repeat and new trade "Glass & Mirror".
in10: Different from 1.0: matches existing items; no PDF reading

try: Finish the import
how:
1. Keep "Rows that match" on "Update the price"
2. Click "Import 3 rows"
expect: A message says "2 items added · 1 updated · 1 skipped"; the shower screen and wallpaper join My Items and Vinyl flooring becomes S$7.30.
in10: Different from 1.0: repeats skipped, matches updated, no duplicates

try: Delete an item that quotes already use
how:
1. Point at "Electrical point, new" and open its ⋮ menu › "Delete"
2. Read the warning, then click "Delete" (don't press Undo)
expect: The warning says the quotes already carrying it keep the line and it can be restored from Deleted Items; the item leaves the list.
in10: Different from 1.0: deleted items can be restored

try: Bring the deleted item back
how:
1. Click the ⋮ menu ("More options", top right) › "Deleted Items · 1"
2. Point at "Delete Forever" on Electrical point, new
3. Click "Restore"
expect: "Delete Forever" is greyed out — it is on quotes, restore it instead — and "Restore" puts the item back in My Items.
in10: Different from 1.0: items on quotes can't be deleted forever

try: Save a whole section for future quotes
how:
1. Click the "My Sections" tab, then "New" › "New section"
2. "Section name": Feature wall package · "Property type": HDB 4-Room · "Tags": Feature wall, Living room
3. Click "Add an item" twice: Fluted feature wall panel, 60, sqft, 42.00 · LED strip light, 1, set, 280.00 (Item · Qty · Unit · Unit price)
4. Click "Save"
expect: A message says "Feature wall package added to My Sections"; its card reads "2 items · S$2,800.00 · HDB 4-Room".
in10: Different from 1.0: Packages are now My Sections

try: Open the studio's templates
how: 1. Click "Company" › "Templates"
expect: It opens on "Quotes": "Default Quote PDF" with a "Default" chip, the "HDB" and "Show flats" folders, and a "1 awaiting approval" chip.
in10: Different from 1.0: Company › Templates, with drafts and versions

try: Make a 40/60 payment split
how:
1. Click the "Payments" tab › "New" › "Blank split"
2. Click the name "Untitled split" and type 40/60
3. Change the first "Share (%)" to 40 and read the line beside "Total"
4. Change the second to 60, then click "Done"
expect: At 90% it warns "10% short — the last payment will not close the quote"; at 100% it reads "Adds up to the quote".
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Write a reusable site-protection note
how:
1. Click the "T&Cs & Notes" tab › "New" › "Additional Notes"
2. Rename "Untitled template" to Site protection
3. In the text, type: Floors and lifts are protected before works start by — then "Insert Token" › "Studio Name"
4. Click "Done"
expect: The text ends with [Studio Name], filled in on each quote; the gallery shows "Site protection" with a "Notes" chip.
in10: Different from 1.0: [bracket] tokens, one library for both

try: Save a site-visit checklist as a task template
how:
1. Click the "Tasks" tab › "New" › "Blank template"; name it Site visit checklist
2. Change "First step" to Measure the site; "Due in (days)": 1
3. Click "Add a step": Photograph the existing condition; "Due in (days)": 1
4. Click "Done"
expect: Its card reads "2 steps · keeps members · descriptions" with a "Due dates" chip, ready for any lead's Tasks tab.
in10: New in 2.0

try: Start a contract template from the studio agreement
how:
1. Click the "Contracts" tab › "New" › "From the studio agreement"
2. Click the title and rename it Renovation Agreement (HDB)
3. Click "eSignatures" and look under "Before the client signs"
4. Close the panel and click "Done"
expect: "Read to the end" and "Tick to accept" are already on for a new template; the gallery now lists "Renovation Agreement (HDB)".
in10: Different from 1.0: read-and-accept set on the template

try: Make the studio agreement the default contract
how:
1. On the "Contracts" tab, open the "Agreements" folder
2. On "Interior Design Service Agreement", open the ⋮ menu › "Set as default"
expect: A message says it is the default contract template and its card carries a "Default" chip.
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Start a quote template from a ready-made design
how:
1. Click the "Quotes" tab › "New" › "Use a ready-made design"
2. Click the "Presentation" card ("Preview" shows its pages; "Back" returns)
3. "Template name": Studio Presentation, then click "Create template"
4. Click "Got it" on the tip bar
expect: The template editor opens on "Studio Presentation" with a "Draft" chip and a cover in the studio's accent colour.
in10: Different from 1.0: whole designs, not preset overlays

try: Add a thank-you line to the page
how:
1. On the "Page" tab (left), click "Title & intro"
2. Click "Add to the page" (bottom left) › "Text"
3. On the right, replace the words in "Text" with: Thank you for choosing Demo Studio,
expect: A "Text" row appears under "Title & intro" and your sentence prints under "Scope of works" on the page.
in10: Different from 1.0: added to the template, not per lead

try: Put the client's name into your line
how:
1. Beside the "Text" box, click "Insert a field" (the { } button)
2. Pick "Client name"
expect: The box ends with {client_name}; under it: "Prints as: Thank you for choosing Demo Studio, Mr & Mrs Tan" — the sample client.
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Remove the line by mistake, then undo
how:
1. At the top right, click "Remove from the page" (the bin)
2. On the message "Text removed", click "Undo"
expect: The Text block disappears from the page and the list, then comes back in the same place.
in10: Same as 1.0

try: See the template drawn with a real quote
how:
1. At the top, click "Preview with: Sample quote"
2. Pick any "OM-…" quote
3. When checked, switch back to "Sample quote"
expect: The pages redraw with that quote's client, lines and totals, then with the sample quote again.
in10: Different from 1.0: your own quotes, not a fixed sample

try: Give this template its own colour
how:
1. Click the "Brand" tab (left)
2. Under "Colours", click the "Accent" swatch and pick a dark green
expect: The cover and the room bands turn green; the Accent row ends "· this template" with a reset button. The brand kit is untouched.
in10: New in 2.0

try: Number the items A1, A2 in each room
how:
1. Click the "Page" tab, then "Items table" in the list
2. On the right, "Item numbers": A1 · A2 · B1
expect: Item numbers on the page read A1, A2… in the first room and B1, B2… in the next.
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Choose what a new quote starts with
how:
1. Click the "New quotes" tab
2. "Payment schedule": 40/60 · "Additional Notes": Site protection
expect: Your split and note are offered from the libraries; the tab warns "Not published yet — quotes can use this template once you press Publish."
in10: Different from 1.0: sections and defaults, never priced lines

try: Publish the template and make it the default
how:
1. Click "Publish" (top right)
2. "What changed": First version · turn on "Make it the studio’s default"
3. Click "Publish"
expect: A message says "Studio Presentation published"; the top shows "Published v1" and "Default", and the button now reads "Published".
in10: Different from 1.0: drafts publish as numbered versions

try: See the template's version history
how: 1. Click "History" (the clock icon at the top)
expect: The History panel lists v1 marked "Current", your note "First version" and your name.
in10: New in 2.0

try: Check the default moved in the gallery
how:
1. Close the History panel
2. Click the back arrow ("Back to Quote templates")
expect: "Studio Presentation" now carries the "Default" chip and "Published v1"; "Default Quote PDF" no longer does.
in10: Same as 1.0

try: See the default in the brand kit preview
how: 1. Click the "Brand kit" tab
expect: The preview on the right is labelled "Default template · Studio Presentation" and shows its first page.
in10: New in 2.0

try: Look at the deleted templates
how:
1. Click the "Quotes" tab
2. Click the ⋮ menu ("More options", top right) › "Deleted Templates · 2"
3. Close the panel
expect: "Copy of Default Quote PDF" and "Test" wait there with "Restore" and "Delete Forever" — nothing is lost at once.
in10: Different from 1.0: deleted templates can be restored

try: Put the studio's default back
how: 1. On "Default Quote PDF", open the ⋮ menu › "Set as default"
expect: A message says "Default Quote PDF is the default template" and the Default chip moves back — chapter 6's quotes start from it.
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Add a question every new lead starts with
how:
1. Click "Company" › "Questionnaire", then "Add question"
2. "Question": Will anyone work from home? · "Type": Single select
3. "Option 1": Yes, every day · "Add option": Some days · "Add option": No
4. Click "Add"
expect: A message says "Question added"; it joins the bottom of the "Question bank" with a "Single select" chip and "Active" on.
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Move your question higher in the list
how: 1. On your new question, click "Move up" (the up arrow) twice
expect: A message says "Order saved" each time and the question sits two places higher; Sophia's questionnaire (chapter 4) follows this order.
in10: Same as 1.0
